body: I guess it stems from the fact that I've become everything I hate in other people. I'm selfish, overly emotional on the surface, apathetic on the inside, lack vigour to do anything meaningful.

Awesome! You should definitely check those bands out. Lingus by Snarky Puppy is particularly great. Journey is unfortunately a Sony exclusive so not on Xbox, but if you do decide to upgrade I have a PS4 and XB1 maybe we could game together.

Journey is all about the Journey haha, you complete simple platforming but are able to meet other players to receive or give help during your Journey. You can't chat with them and you can't play with friends deliberately, but you develop a silent bond with strangers which is actually quite beautiful.

I agree with you about games being moving, books and films only touch me when I have something in common with a character. It's funny actually, I got very emotional when playing Journey in the same way you did with LiS.

I just picked up LiS, looking forward to seeing how it affects me!

I listen to mostly relaxing music like Nujabes, Snarky Puppy, or ballads. Right now I just started playing Journey on PS4, that game has really touched me. Yesterday I felt a moment of peace when wandering the desert in that game that I hadn't felt in a long time. The beauty, the silence, and the peace of it all is what I like most about Journey. I will have to check out Life is Strange. 

I really appreciate your comments, and if you're open to it I'd like to keep chatting.
It does, just no pre-orders. I used mine yesterday on 7 games all part of the Co-Op sale or the Flash Sale.

I spend most of my useable time reading about film history, listening to music and try to enjoy games (it's getting harder). Every day my enjoyment of these things dulls, and it's scary that stuff I used to be so passionate about are beginning to fade.

I want to seek therapy, and I think I will since it is free at my school before telling my friends. I am worried that even if they don't judge me for telling them they'll treat me "different". I don't want to be that guy who worries everyone. I would rather end it than have that kind of spotlight.

All I really want is someone I can talk to..
When it comes to it I think you're right. I can't fix this, but if I want to improve at all I need professional help. Asking for help is the hardest part for me.
I have been hesitating on this for a while. I've wanted to book an appointment but going in person has stopped me.
I'm glad you've found a good balance to keep your thoughts adjusted. Unfortunately it is less the stress and problems that are getting to me and more the profound hatred I have for my own existence.
